what_it_does: When designing hardware chips in register-transfer level (RTL) — a low-level hardware description — optimization tools simplify gate-level logic to reduce power, area, and latency. SmaRTLy improves this process by recognizing hidden logical relationships between signals that traditional optimization tools miss. By reconstructing multiplexer trees (common switching circuits) to exploit these relationships, the technique reduces total gate count and improves design efficiency.
